lane: Coordinator lane 3/4 — Tekken + KoC2 moves (owner order 2026-11-22)
method: Headless gate evaluation from pairing-audit.json (manifest-grounded). No browser, no match run: match-run.py needs Playwright/Chromium (subagent cannot run a live browser) and the gates refuse every Tekken/KoC2 clip before any frame renders, so a browser run would refuse 383/383 + KoC2 without producing a frame.

gates.G1_decoded_in_hand: clip JSON exists in Bannon repo assets/moves/clips/
gates.G3_root_travel: root x/z travel present in the clip
gates.G4_library_mapped: mapped to a named Bannon library move
gates.G5_contact_keyframe: clip covers its registry first active frame
gates.G6_renderer_can_play: match renderer accepts the clip format (2K26 quat clips only today)

match_proof.rigs_ready: Finn / Big Cass / Elias / Enzo port zips present in workspace (EnzoAndCassPorts.zip 1.1 GB, EliasPorts.zip 167 MB, FinnBalorEntrancePort.zip 83 MB) but unopened here — ports are 2K26 .clips banks, not Tekken/KoC2 clips, and no Tekken/KoC2 clip passes the gates to play on them.
match_proof.note: No stills or MP4s were produced in this lane because producing them would require playing a clip that fails the gates — i.e. inventing a match. stills/ and video/ hold NOT-PROOF-YET notes instead. The first real Tekken/KoC2 match proof is owed after: (1) King artifact rescue + --compression none re-extract, (2) pairing + root restore, (3) a position-pose -> rig retarget build for the match renderer, (4) a VM/browser bout run.
